```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(tibble)

filter_rt_for_lmm <- function(data, analysis_name, sd_cutoff = 2.5) {
  n_total <- nrow(data)
  incorrect <- !is.na(data$Correct_or_not) & data$Correct_or_not != 1
  correct_with_rt <- !is.na(data$Correct_or_not) &
    data$Correct_or_not == 1 & is.finite(data$Response_time)
  rt_mean <- mean(data$Response_time[correct_with_rt], na.rm = TRUE)
  rt_sd <- sd(data$Response_time[correct_with_rt], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  rt_outlier <- rep(FALSE, n_total)
  rt_outlier[correct_with_rt] <-
    abs(data$Response_time[correct_with_rt] - rt_mean) > sd_cutoff * rt_sd
  
  report <- tibble(
    Analysis = analysis_name,
    Total_trials = n_total,
    Incorrect_n = sum(incorrect, na.rm = TRUE),
    Incorrect_pct_total = round(100 * sum(incorrect, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total, 2),
    RT_outlier_n = sum(rt_outlier, na.rm = TRUE),
    RT_outlier_pct_total = round(100 * sum(rt_outlier, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total, 2),
    RT_outlier_pct_correct = round(100 * sum(rt_outlier, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(correct_with_rt, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Retained_n = sum(correct_with_rt & !rt_outlier, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  cat("\n", analysis_name, " -- exclusion report (percentages are of all trials unless noted):\n",
      sep = "")
  print(report)
  
  list(
    data = data[correct_with_rt & !rt_outlier, , drop = FALSE],
    report = report
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Check SL learning
learning_data <- read.csv("Learning_all.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
demo <- read.csv("Demo_all.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
demo$Name <- demo$PID
data <- learning_data

data$Response_time <- as.numeric(data$Response_time)
data$Event_type <- factor(data$Event_type)
data$FRD <- as.factor(data$FRD)
data$Correct_or_not <- as.numeric(data$Correct_or_not)

data_target <- data[data$Appearing_Sti_type=="TarN"|data$Appearing_Sti_type=="TarV",]
data_target <- data_target %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Name, Trial_n) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Name) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    prev_Event_type = dplyr::lag(Event_type, 1),
    switch_status = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(prev_Event_type) ~ NA_character_,
      prev_Event_type == Event_type ~ "repeat",
      prev_Event_type != Event_type ~ "switch",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(switch_status))

data_target_pid <- data_target %>%
  dplyr::distinct(PID = Name) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(PID)
cat("\nPIDs in data_target:\n")
print(data_target_pid)
cat("Number of PIDs in data_target:", nrow(data_target_pid), "\n")

data_target_rows_by_pid <- data_target %>%
  dplyr::count(Name, name = "n_rows") %>%
  dplyr::rename(PID = Name) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(PID)
cat("\nNumber of rows/trials per PID in data_target:\n")
print(data_target_rows_by_pid)
cat("Total rows in data_target:", nrow(data_target), "\n")
cat("Mean rows per PID in data_target:",
    round(nrow(data_target) / nrow(data_target_pid), 2), "\n")

data_target$Trial_n <- scale(data_target$Trial_n)
data_target$FRD <- factor(data_target$FRD, levels = c("0", "1"))
data_target$Event_type <- factor(data_target$Event_type, levels = c("E_High", "E_Low"))
data_target$switch_status <- factor(data_target$switch_status, levels = c("repeat", "switch"))

contrasts(data_target$FRD) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)
contrasts(data_target$Event_type) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)
contrasts(data_target$switch_status) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)

data_target_parti <- data_target %>%
  dplyr::group_by(FRD, Event_type, switch_status) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Acc = mean(Correct_or_not, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
print(data_target_parti)

# Check low performance parti
data_target_parti2 <- data_target%>%group_by(Name)%>%
  summarise(
    Acc = mean(Correct_or_not)
  )
print(data_target_parti2)
SD = sd(data_target_parti2$Acc)
mean = mean(data_target_parti2$Acc)
lower = mean - 3*SD

data_target_rt_result <- filter_rt_for_lmm(data_target, "Target detection")
data_target_rt <- data_target_rt_result$data

data_target_rt_parti <- data_target_rt%>%group_by(FRD,Event_type)%>%
  summarise(
    RT = mean(Response_time)
  )
print(data_target_rt_parti)
```

```{r}
# LMM assumption check: inspect residuals after fitting, not the raw RT data itself.
model_acc <- glmer(Correct_or_not ~ Event_type * FRD * switch_status + (1 | Name),
               data = data_target,
               family = binomial(link = "logit"))
cat("\nAccuracy model summary with 95% CI:\n")
print(summary(model_acc))
print(confint(model_acc, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald", level = 0.95))

model_rt <- lmer(Response_time ~ Event_type * FRD * switch_status + (1 | Name),
               data = data_target_rt)
cat("\nRT model summary with 95% CI:\n")
print(summary(model_rt))
print(anova(model_rt))
print(confint(model_rt, parm = "beta_", method = "Wald", level = 0.95))

# Post-hoc analyses for significant effects
emmeans::emm_options(pbkrtest.limit = 100000, lmerTest.limit = 100000)

acc_emmean_event_switch <- emmeans(model_acc, ~ FRD | Event_type * switch_status)
acc_posthoc_switch <- contrast(emmeans(model_acc, ~ switch_status | Event_type), method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")

cat("\nACC - Switch contrasts within each Event x FRD condition:\n")
print(summary(acc_posthoc_switch, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))

rt_emmean <- emmeans(model_rt, ~ FRD | Event_type * switch_status)
rt_posthoc_frd <- contrast(emmeans(model_rt, ~ FRD), method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")
rt_posthoc_switch <- contrast(emmeans(model_rt, ~ switch_status | Event_type), method = "pairwise", adjust = "bonferroni")

cat("\nRT - FRD contrasts within each Event x Switch condition:\n")
print(summary(rt_posthoc_frd, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
cat("\nRT - Switch contrasts within each Event x FRD condition:\n")
print(summary(rt_posthoc_switch, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE), level = 0.95))
```

```{r}
# Check SL strategy
data <- learning_data

if (!"FRD" %in% names(data)) {
  data <- dplyr::left_join(data, demo[, c("Name", "FRD")], by = "Name")
}

if ("Age_matched" %in% names(data)) {
  data$Age_matched <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$Age_matched))
  data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(Age_matched == 1)
} else if ("Age_matched" %in% names(demo)) {
  data <- dplyr::left_join(data, demo[, c("Name", "Age_matched")], by = "Name")
  data$Age_matched <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$Age_matched))
  data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(Age_matched == 1)
}

data$Response_time <- as.numeric(data$Response_time)
data$Event_type <- factor(data$Event_type, levels = c("E_High", "E_Low"))
data$FRD <- factor(data$FRD, levels = c("0", "1"))
data$Probe_type <- factor(data$Probe_type, levels = c("Paired", "Unpaired"))
data$Correct_or_not <- as.numeric(data$Correct_or_not)

contrasts(data$FRD) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)
contrasts(data$Event_type) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)
contrasts(data$Probe_type) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)

data_prob <- data[data$Appearing_Sti_type=="ProbN"|data$Appearing_Sti_type=="ProbV",]
data_prob_parti <- data_prob%>%group_by(FRD,Event_type,Probe_type)%>%
  summarise(
    Acc = mean(Correct_or_not)
  )
print(data_prob_parti)

data_prob_rt_result <- filter_rt_for_lmm(data_prob, "Cue identification")
data_prob_rt <- data_prob_rt_result$data

data_prob_rt_parti <- data_prob_rt%>%group_by(FRD,Event_type,Probe_type)%>%
  summarise(
    RT = mean(Response_time)
  )
print(data_prob_rt_parti)

null <- glmer(Correct_or_not ~ (1 | Name),
               data = data_prob,
               family = binomial(link = "logit"))
model_prob_acc <- glmer(Correct_or_not ~ Event_type * FRD * Probe_type + (1 | Name),
               data = data_prob,
               family = binomial(link = "logit"))

anova(model_prob_acc,null)
summary(model_prob_acc)



model_prob_rt <- lmer(Response_time ~ Event_type * FRD * Probe_type + (1 | Name),
               data = data_prob_rt)
summary(model_prob_rt)

emmean <- emmeans(model_prob_acc,~ Event_type * FRD * Probe_type)
contrast <- contrast(emmean, interaction = "pairwise", by = c("Event_type","Probe_type"), adjust = "bonferroni")
contrast
```

```{r}
# Check explicit task
data <- read.csv("Testing_all.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (!"FRD" %in% names(data)) {
  data <- dplyr::left_join(data, demo[, c("Name", "FRD")], by = "Name")
}

if ("Age_matched" %in% names(data)) {
  data$Age_matched <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$Age_matched))
  data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(Age_matched == 1)
} else if ("Age_matched" %in% names(demo)) {
  data <- dplyr::left_join(data, demo[, c("Name", "Age_matched")], by = "Name")
  data$Age_matched <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(data$Age_matched))
  data <- data %>% dplyr::filter(Age_matched == 1)
}

data$Response_time <- as.numeric(data$Response_time)
data$FRD <- factor(data$FRD, levels = c("0", "1"))
data$Correct_or_not <- as.numeric(data$Correct_or_not)
data$Subset_type <- factor(data$Subset_type, levels = c("High", "Low"))

contrasts(data$FRD) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)
contrasts(data$Subset_type) <- matrix(c(-0.5, 0.5), ncol = 1)

data_parti <- data%>%group_by(FRD)%>%
  summarise(
    Acc = mean(Correct_or_not)
  )
print(data_parti)

data_rt_result <- filter_rt_for_lmm(data, "Target recognition")
data_rt <- data_rt_result$data

data_rt_parti <- data_rt%>%group_by(FRD)%>%
  summarise(
    RT = mean(Response_time)
  )
print(data_rt_parti)

model_test_acc <- glmer(Correct_or_not ~ FRD * Subset_type + (1 | Name),
               data = data,
               family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(model_test_acc)

model_test_rt <- lmer(Response_time ~ FRD * Subset_type + (1 | Name),
               data = data_rt)
summary(model_test_rt)

model_test_rt2 <- lmer(Response_time ~ FRD + (1 | Name),
               data = data_rt)
summary(model_test_rt2)
```
